description: This Java source file defines the class 'SearchUpdaterStream', which manages a reactive stream for updating a search index with changes from a cache of Thing modifications. It sets up configurable restartable Akka Streams with flow pipelines, including enforcement, MongoDB updates, blocking namespace filtering, and supervision.

classes.name: SearchUpdaterStream
classes.description: Manages a restartable Akka stream pipeline for continuously updating a search index based on Thing change events, with filtering, enforcement, and MongoDB persistence.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of SearchUpdaterStream with dependencies configured from provided parameters.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the perpetually running stream with a kill switch, using the provided actor context.

methods.name: createRestartSource
methods.description: Creates the restartable source of change events, applying namespace filtering and enforcement.

methods.name: createRestartSink
methods.description: Creates the restartable sink that writes to MongoDB and applies bulk operation flow.

methods.name: filterMapKeysByBlockedNamespaces
methods.description: Flow that filters out entries in the change map whose Thing IDs belong to blocked namespaces.

methods.name: blockNamespaceFlow
methods.description: Flow that filters elements based on whether their namespace is blocked, using a supplied extraction function.

methods.name: namespaceOfWriteModel
methods.description: Helper method to extract the namespace string from an AbstractWriteModel.
